name: mage-os/module-advanced-report
description: Advanced sales and catalog reporting for Magento Open Source / Mage-OS.

suggest.magento/module-checkout: Provides the checkout/cart/delete_quote_after setting read by the cart reports; the default is used when it is not installed.
suggest.magento/module-inventory-api: Used to read multi-source stock levels for the catalog_stock dataset when MSI is enabled.
suggest.magento/module-open-search: Used as an alternative reporting data source when OpenSearch is enabled.
